title: Sauce Arm - SAO++ edition
credit: Original design: Caleb Marting, Open Sauce 2026 badge SAOs (MIT), github.com/calebmarting/os2026-badge
notes: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LED. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.
The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.
LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).
D1 = the light in the gripper's round palm, where the maker's 5 mm LED had its legs. Red through-board LED, about 1 mA through 1.3 k.
The maker's solder jumper (LED fed from SAO pin 1 or from GPIO2, so a badge could blink it) is not carried over: see the README.
